lines.cap: Cows face north. And nobody knows why.
lines.say: Cows face north. And nobody knows why.

lines.cap: In 2008, scientists studied satellite images of more than eight thousand cattle, all over the world.
lines.say: In 2008, scientists studied satellite images of more than eight thousand cattle, all over the world.

lines.cap: Grazing or resting, they kept lining up the same way. Roughly north to south.
lines.say: Grazing or resting, they kept lining up the same way. Roughly north to south.

lines.cap: Deer did it too. Even when the wind and the sun came from other directions.
lines.say: Deer did it too. Even when the wind and the sun came from other directions.

lines.cap: One idea: cows can sense Earth's magnetic field, like a built in compass.
lines.say: One idea: cows can sense Earth's magnetic field, like a built in compass.

lines.cap: Under power lines, which disturb the magnetic field, the pattern fell apart.
lines.say: Under power lines, which disturb the magnetic field, the pattern fell apart.

lines.cap: But another team couldn't find the same pattern. So the mystery is still open.
lines.say: But another team couldn't find the same pattern. So the mystery is still open.

lines.cap: Next time you pass a field of cows, check which way they're facing.
lines.say: Next time you pass a field of cows, check which way they're facing.
